---
title: "Visualising flow validation"
---

Plot validation results to compare methods and find where errors concentrate.
Matplotlib is included in the base package; geographic maps require `.[plot]`.

```python
from debiaspy import (
    adjust_inverse_penetration, debiaspy_example_data,
    validate_flow_overall, validate_flow_plot_metrics,
)

bundle = debiaspy_example_data(n_areas=25)
adjusted = adjust_inverse_penetration(bundle["mpd_od"], bundle["coverage"])
validation = validate_flow_overall(
    adjusted, bundle["benchmark_od"],
    comparisons=["raw_vs_benchmark", "adjusted_vs_benchmark"],
)
figure = validate_flow_plot_metrics(validation)
figure.savefig("validation_metrics.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
```

Residual, scatter, residual-band and distribution plots accept the corresponding
validation outputs. Structure plots use spatial summaries; LISA maps additionally
require area polygons in a GeoDataFrame. Match polygon identifiers to the
classified areas and inspect missing boundaries. Outline geometries are
reprojected to the boundary CRS when both CRSs are available.
